summary: Describes a procedure for renumbering an IPv6 network from one prefix to another without a flag day. It uses the ability to give interfaces multiple addresses for a make-before-break transition and addresses naming and configuration issues. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Moving to a new address while keeping the old one active for a while means no mail gets lost. This memo explains how to do that for a whole network without a sudden switchover.

questions: how to renumber an ipv6 network
